from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u017/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=programs/'task-42f97ab4.py'
program_code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [color for color in counts if color != background]
    source = max(colors, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == source]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if sum(grid[r][c] == source for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) >= 3:
            for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                if out[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if sum(grid[r][c] == source for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) >= 3:
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                if out[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_code)
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
